question: Are there any active flood or coastal alerts at 116-02 Rockaway Beach Boulevard right now?

plan.rationale: The query asks for current flood or coastal alerts at a specific address, indicating a live conditions check.

claims.text: This address is mapped within FEMA flood zone X, per NFHL FIRM panel 3604970379F, effective 2007.
No FloodNet sensors are deployed within 600 meters of this address.
Thirty-six NYC 311 flood-related complaints were filed within 200 meters of this location in the last five years, with the most common descriptor being Sewer Backup (Use Comments) (SA).
The latest reading at Sandy Hook, NJ, shows a tide of 5.18 feet above mean lower low water, observed at 2026-09-26 17:24.

The nearest USGS stream gauge, Conselyeas Pond Tributary At Rosedale NY (01311810, 12.1 km away), recorded a stage of 1.07 feet and a discharge of 13.7 cubic feet per second, observed at 2026-09-26 21:00 UTC.
There are three active NWS alerts at this point: Coastal Flood Warning (Severe), High Surf Advisory (Minor), and Rip Current Statement (Moderate).

The Ophelia After-Action Report from the MTA, dated October 2023, addresses the response to the Comptroller’s Request for Information on the 9/29 Flash Flood Event, specifically on page 38, Attachment B Exhibit 2D.

Flood Resilience at NYCHA, as detailed on page 74 of the document, outlines lessons learned through the Hurricane Sandy Disaster Recovery Program, focusing on sites such as ASTORIA, BARUCH, BEACH 41ST STREET, CAMPOS PLAZA II, CAREY GARDENS, CARLTON MANOR, CONEY ISLAND (SITE 8), CONEY ISLAND HOUSES, CONEY ISLAND IB, CONEY ISLAND 4&5, EAST RIVER, GOWANUS, GRAVESEND HOMES, LA GUARDIA, and LAVANBURG HOMES.

The MTA Climate Resilience Roadmap, updated in October 2025, identifies a stretch of 4 Avenue Brooklyn served by five stations impacted by heavy rainfall, highlighting the need for city action due to chronic flooding in the Gowanus neighborhood.
